zg361ch.950 = {
    type = character_event
    theme = stewardship
    title = zg361ch.950.t
    desc = zg361ch.950.desc
    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_owner
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_subject
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_cycle
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_case

        zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
        scope:zg361_ch_d_event_subject = {
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_subject
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_cycle
                EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_ch_d_event_case
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
    name = zg361ch.950.a
    custom_tooltip = zg361ch.950.a.tt
    scope:zg361_ch_d_event_subject = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_player_batch_route value = 1 }
        zg361_career_hc_m019_background_apply_effect = yes
    }
}

            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject

            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_m_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_m_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_m_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_m_feedback_revision
            DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_owner
            DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_subject
            DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_cycle
            DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_case
            DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_state
            DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_pending
            DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_expired
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
                    var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                }
                trigger_else = { always = no }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m_timeout_stage_01_effect = yes
        }
    }

            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_m_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_m_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_m_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_m_feedback_revision
            DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_owner
            DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_subject
            DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_cycle
            DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_case
            DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_state
            DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_pending
            DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_expired
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
                    var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                }
                trigger_else = { always = no }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m_timeout_stage_04_effect = yes
        }
    }
}

    }
    if = {

            scope:zg361_ch_n_event_subject = {
                has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
                var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1

    }
    else = { root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.99 days = 1 } } }
        }
    }
}

                var:zg361_ch_player_batch_route = 3

zg361ch.1602 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        zg361_case_kernel_expire_deadline_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_p_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision
            DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_owner
            DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_subject
            DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_cycle
            DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_case
            DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_state
            DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_pending
            DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_ch_p_s1_x_deadline_expired
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
                    var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                }
                trigger_else = { always = no }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_p_timeout_stage_01_effect = yes
        }
    }
}

# D+1 hidden queue edge: P closed -> Q opens.
zg361ch.955 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes
    trigger = {
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_owner
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_subject
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_cycle
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_case
        this = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_owner
        zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
        scope:zg361_ch_p_event_subject = {
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            var:zg361_case_p_owner = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_owner
            var:zg361_case_p_subject = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_subject
            var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_cycle
            var:zg361_case_p_case_serial = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_case
            var:zg361_case_p_state = 6
            var:zg361_case_p_active = 0
        }
    }
    immediate = {
        scope:zg361_ch_p_event_subject = {
            zg361_career_hc_prepare_transfer_vacancy_effect = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                    any_vassal = { zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes }
                }
                zg361_career_hc_open_q_case_effect = yes
            }
            else = {
                zg361_career_hc_finalize_p_portfolio_effect = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { NOT = { zg361_career_hc_automanage_enabled_trigger = yes } } }
                    root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.906 days = 1 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Player manager business window #121; its only successor is D+1.
zg361ch.121 = {
    type = character_event
    theme = stewardship
    title = zg361ch.m121.name
    desc = zg361ch.m121.desc
    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_owner
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_subject
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_cycle
        exists = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_case
        this = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_owner
        zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
        scope:zg361_ch_q_event_subject = {
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_subject
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_cycle
                EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_ch_q_event_case
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
    name = zg361ch.m121.a
    custom_tooltip = zg361ch.m121.a.tt
    scope:zg361_ch_q_event_subject = {
        zg361_career_hc_m121_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:zg361_ch_q_event_subject = {
                has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
                var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1
            }
        }
        scope:zg361_ch_q_event_subject = {
            if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_ch_player_batch_route
            OR = {
                var:zg361_ch_player_batch_route = 1
                var:zg361_ch_player_batch_route = 2
                var:zg361_ch_player_batch_route = 3
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m122_background_apply_effect = yes
    }
    else = { root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.122 days = 1 } } }
        }
    }
}
